text: This project in GitHub transforms any material into a complete class, with teachers and colleagues of room made of artificial intelligence. It is called Open Mike. It is a team of agents, programs of artificial intelligence that work alone, each with a role. And they teach the material that you are in trouble. The project came out in March and has already passed 44,000 stars in GitHub. It works like this. You send the material or the theme that will fall into your test, or even the PDF of the poster. And in a few minutes it sets a complete class for you. Then a virtual teacher enters, which explains everything in a white frame, drawing and speaking in loud voice. Meanwhile, virtual room colleagues are asking questions together with you, like in a real classroom. But what impresses the most is this. In the end, he asks you questions, corrects each answer at the time and gives you a note for your performance. And the best, the code is open and free. You just pay for an artificial intelligence model you want to choose, or roll a free model on your computer. Nothing to pay dearly for a particular teacher. I want the link. Comment "study" that I send you on DM, step by step to install. And follow so you don't miss the next one.
